identity.name: Santos de Cartier
identity.one_liner: The 2018 Santos de Cartier in stainless steel with the QuickSwitch bracelet — the first Cartier sport watch with the bracelet-and-strap interchange system.

narrative.story: The 2018 Santos de Cartier is the modern reissue of the 1904 Santos (the first men's wristwatch, designed by Louis Cartier for his friend Alberto Santos-Dumont). The 39.8mm case, the 1847 MC caliber, and the QuickSwitch bracelet (allows swapping the bracelet for a strap without tools) are the 2018 redesign. The Santos is the most-cited Cartier sport watch of the 2020s and the watch a collector cites when they want a steel sport watch that is not a Royal Oak or a Nautilus.
